name: filter-bar
title: Filter bar
description: Filters as chips that read as sentences, each with its own editor, and the result count live as they change.

FilterBarRoot.description: The bar on its own: the parts go inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change: a chip added, edited into a complete value, or removed.

props.name: resultCount
props.description: How many rows the filters let through, shown live ("14 results"). Leave it out to hide the count.

props.name: resultLabel
props.description: The count's words, "14 deals": `number` is the rolling number, `count` picks the plural. Defaults to the `filterResults` label.

props.name: views
props.description: Saved filters, in a menu that sets them. The one that matches the filters is checked and names the menu.

props.name: onSaveView
props.description: Shows Save view while the filters match no view; called with the name typed and the filters.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: Chips shown before the rest fold into "+3 more".

props.name: shortcut
props.description: One key that opens `+ Filter` while focus is in the bar's parent and not in a field; shown as Kbd. `false` for none.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target of the editors and menus. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: today
props.description: Today, for the editors' calendars. Defaults to now.

FilterBarSearch.description: The bar's search field (Input sm with a search icon): its text is the bar's `query`. Backspace in it while empty removes the last chip. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `input`.

FilterBarChips.description: The chips, then "+3 more" past `maxVisible`. Its `div` is `display: contents`, so the chips wrap along with whatever sits next to them in the bar. Other props, `ref` included, go to that `div`.

FilterBarAdd.description: `+ Filter`: a menu of the fields; picking one adds its chip with the editor open. Shows the bar's `shortcut` as Kbd. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

FilterBarCount.description: "14 results", its digits rolling as the count changes. Nothing without `resultCount`. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `span`.

FilterBarViews.description: The views menu (named after the view the filters match, or "Views") and Save view, shown while the filters match no view. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

FilterBar.description: The bar from props: the search (with `search`), the chips, `+ Filter`, then the count and the views at the end of the row. Other props, `ref` included, go to the bar's `div`.

props.name: search
props.description: A search field before the chips; its text is `query`.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: The search's placeholder. Defaults to the `search` label.
